fact_check.fact: Target population requires a baseline MMSE of 22 or higher.
fact_check.note: Matches registry Inclusion Criteria: 'Screening MMSE score >= 22'.

fact_check.fact: Primary outcome is change in CDR-SB at Week 72.
Trontinemab passively crosses the blood-brain barrier due to its smaller size.
fact_check.note: Trontinemab uses active transferrin receptor (TfR)-mediated transcytosis to cross the blood-brain barrier, rather than passive diffusion.

fact_check.fact: Phase 1b/2a data showed 91% PET negative plaque clearance.
fact_check.note: This statistic is heavily cited by media and investors, but is not present in this prospective registry document.

research_page.title: TRONTIER 2: Trontinemab in early symptomatic AD (Phase 3)
research_page.description: Registry protocol for a Phase 3 trial evaluating the transferrin receptor-binding anti-amyloid antibody trontinemab in 800 patients with early Alzheimer's disease.
research_page.takeaway_md: Roche is advancing its Brainshuttle anti-amyloid antibody, trontinemab, into a massive Phase 3 program. The TRONTIER 2 trial will evaluate cognitive outcomes over 72 weeks, seeking to prove that enhanced blood-brain barrier penetration translates to superior clinical efficacy.
key_findings_md: The primary endpoint is change in the Clinical Dementia Rating-Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB) at Week 72 (registry record).
The target population requires confirmed amyloid pathology and a screening MMSE score of 22 or higher (registry record).
research_page.methods_md: Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial. Enrolling approximately 800 adults aged 50 to 90 with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease. Treatment duration is 72 weeks.
research_page.trial_evidence_md: [TRONTIER 2](/trials/trontinemab-nct07170150) is part of a broad late-stage clinical program for trontinemab. The rapid progression to Phase 3 prior to final Phase 1/2 peer-reviewed publication suggests robust interim biomarker data from the ongoing [Brainshuttle AD](/trials/trontinemab-nct04639050) trial.
research_page.sentiment_md: Public and investor sentiment is highly optimistic, driven by early Phase 1b/2a biomarker data showing rapid amyloid clearance. However, enthusiasm sometimes outpaces evidence, with some retail investors prematurely assuming these biomarker improvements guarantee superior cognitive slowing before Phase 3 trials read out.
caveats_md: This document is a prospective registry protocol, not a peer-reviewed report of clinical results.
The relationship between rapid amyloid clearance via Brainshuttle delivery and actual cognitive benefit remains unproven until Phase 3 completion.
relates_to_md: [Amyloid hypothesis](/research/amyloid-hypothesis) — Trontinemab targets amyloid clearance via a novel active-transport delivery mechanism.

trial_pages.title: TRONTIER 2
trial_pages.description: Phase 3 trial evaluating the Brainshuttle antibody trontinemab in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.population: Early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease (MCI to mild dementia)
trial_pages.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to Week 72 in CDR-SB
trial_pages.why_md: This trial aims to determine if the rapid amyloid clearance seen in early trontinemab studies translates to clinical cognitive benefit. By using a transferrin receptor 'Brainshuttle' mechanism, Roche hopes to achieve better efficacy and lower ARIA rates than first-generation anti-amyloid therapies.

trial_pages.title: Brainshuttle AD
trial_pages.description: Phase 2 multiple ascending dose study of trontinemab in prodromal or mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.population: Prodromal or mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
trial_pages.primary_endpoint: Adverse events and change in brain amyloid load
trial_pages.why_md: As the foundational clinical study for Roche's Brainshuttle technology, this trial evaluates whether active transport via the transferrin receptor safely increases antibody penetration into the central nervous system.

timeline_entries.title: 2025-11 — TRONTIER 2 begins
timeline_entries.body_md: Roche initiates [TRONTIER 2](/trials/trontinemab-nct07170150), a massive Phase 3 program evaluating the transferrin receptor-binding Brainshuttle antibody trontinemab in early Alzheimer's disease.
